inlines.v: IMPLO'RE, verb transitive [Latin imploro; in and ploro, to cry out.] 1. To call upon or for, in supplication; to beseech; to pray earnestly; to petition with urgency; to entreat; as, to implore the forgiveness of sins; to implore mercy. Imploring all the gods that reign above. 2. To ask earnestly; to beg. IMPLO'RE, verb intransitive To entreat; to beg. IMPLO'RE, noun Earnest supplication. [Not used.]
